title: Data and code for: Circular economy pathways for steelmaking: resource footprints, fossil dependence, and value creation across metallurgical cycles
description:
Data and code accompanying the article "Circular economy pathways for steelmaking: resource footprints, fossil dependence, and value creation across metallurgical cycles" by Tetiana Salashenko, Viktoriia Khaustova, Mykola Kyzym, Olha Ilyash, Yevhen Kotliarov and Igor Shulga (submitted to Environmental Economics, 2026).

The archive contains a domestic input-output base for Ukraine, India, the United States and Saudi Arabia (2015, 2019, 2021, 2022) aggregated from the OECD Inter-Country Input-Output tables (2025 edition) to 13 industries, a Jupyter notebook and an equivalent Python script that compute all indicators of the study, and the resulting tables (A1-B2) and figures (2-7).
